# Discovery Workflow — Visual Reference

A guide to every `/discover` command, when to use it, and how the phases connect.

---

## Phase 1: Project Setup (once)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  /discover  →  Set up a new project                             │
│                                                                  │
│  Creates:  00 - Registers/    01 - Sessions/                     │
│            02 - Analysis/     03 - Deliverables/                 │
│            04 - Backlog/      00 - Project/preferences.md        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
              ┌───────────────────────────────┐
              │  Set authoring preferences     │
              │  AC style, FR style,           │
              │  Solution Notes style          │
              └───────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Phase 2: Iterative Session Processing (repeat for each workshop)

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  SESSION 1                                                           │
│                                                                      │
│  [Before]  Prepare for an upcoming workshop                          │
│            → agenda + facilitation guide                             │
│                                                                      │
│  [After]   Process a workshop session                                │
│            → reads inbox file / paste notes                          │
│            → writes  01 - Sessions/YYYY-MM-DD - Title/              │
│                      Discovery Notes.md                              │
│                      _index.md (session summary)                     │
│            → updates evidence registers (pain points, requirements…) │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              │
              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  SESSION 2  (same flow — repeat for every workshop)                  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Phase 3: Backlog Generation

After 2+ sessions you have two paths:

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PATH A — All-in-one (most common)                                   │
│                                                                      │
│  Build the backlog  (manage-backlog)                                 │
│                                                                      │
│  Internally runs a decision tree:                                    │
│                                                                      │
│  On first run:                                                       │
│    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│    │  Full Build — reads all registers + sessions                │   │
│    │  → STORY-001…STORY-N generated by model                     │   │
│    │  → Writes Backlog Tracker.xlsx (all items)                  │   │
│    │  → Writes 04 - Backlog/_index.md                            │   │
│    │  → Writes 04 - Backlog/epics/EPIC-01 - Name.md              │   │
│    └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                      │
│  After first run — menu shown:                                       │
│    ├─ [new session ready]  Add new session to backlog  (delta)       │
│    ├─  Refresh pending-only workbook  (default — filters pushed)     │
│    ├─  Super option: rebuild everything from scratch  (⚠ renumbers)  │
│    └─  Done                                                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PATH B — Granular commands (run individually or in sequence)        │
│                                                                      │
│  1.  Generate Backlog                                                │
│      → Generates story skeletons + epic/feature structure only       │
│      → Same full/delta/rebuild logic as manage-backlog               │
│      → Does NOT fill FRs or solution notes                           │
│                                                                      │
│  2.  Generate Functional Requirements                                │
│      → Reads existing workbook                                       │
│      → Fills missing  functional_requirements  column only           │
│      → Prompts: fill missing only (recommended) or overwrite all     │
│      → Never touches IDs, story text, or solution notes              │
│                                                                      │
│  3.  Generate Solution Comments                                      │
│      → Same pattern but fills  solution_notes  column only           │
│      → Prompts: fill missing only or overwrite all                   │
│      → Never touches IDs, story text, or FRs                        │
│                                                                      │
│  manage-backlog = Generate Backlog + Generate FR + Generate Sol.     │
│  (but runs them as a combined flow with one workbook write)          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Phase 4: Delta — Adding a 3rd Session

```
Session 1 ──┐
Session 2 ──┼──► Full Build ──► Backlog Tracker.xlsx  (STORY-001…031)
             │                    _manifest.json
             │
Session 3 ──┘  [discovered later]

             Run  manage-backlog  (or Generate Backlog):
             ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │  "Add new session to backlog" — additive delta        │
             │  → reads Session 3 notes only                         │
             │  → model produces only NEW items                      │
             │  → existing STORY-001…031 IDs preserved               │
             │  → new items assigned STORY-032…N                     │
             │  → workbook updated (pending view) + markdown updated  │
             │  → delta summary written to  04 - Backlog/deltas/     │
             └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Phase 5: Review, Push & Sync

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  User reviews  Backlog Tracker.xlsx                                  │
│                                                                      │
│  ├─ Mark  Disregarded = Y  on items to exclude permanently          │
│  │   Then run:  Mark stories refined  → auto-persists to            │
│  │              disregarded/disregard-record.md                      │
│  │              Item never regenerated or pushed                     │
│  │                                                                   │
│  └─ Leave remaining items as pending for JIRA push                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              │
              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Push backlog to JIRA  (requires PM tool MCP (Atlassian or Azure DevOps))                     │
│  → Creates epics/stories in JIRA                                     │
│  → Writes  pushed/push-record.md  (JIRA key ↔ backlog ID mapping)   │
│  → JIRA becomes source of truth from this point                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              │
              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Sync JIRA status  (requires PM tool MCP (Atlassian or Azure DevOps))                         │
│  → Refreshes JIRA key / status back into local manifest             │
│  → Run periodically to keep local mirror up to date                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              │
              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Next  manage-backlog  open — auto-detects:                         │
│  ├─ Pushed items filtered from xlsx (pending-only view)             │
│  └─ New sessions → "Add new session" option offered automatically   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Phase 6: Refinement Gate

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Mark stories refined                                                │
│                                                                      │
│  Reads workbook → for stories that have acceptance criteria:         │
│  → Writes  artifacts/{STORY-KEY}/refinement-notes.md                │
│  → Status: Ready for Design (JIRA transition via /design)           │
│                                                                      │
│  Also auto-persists newly-disregarded workbook items to record file  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Supporting Commands (available at any point)

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Analyze and prioritize** | Rank pain points by business value / risk |
| **Check for conflicts** | Surface contradictions across sessions |
| **Synthesize insights** | Cross-session themes and patterns |
| **Compose a deliverable** | Client-facing document (SoW, discovery report…) |
| **Audit the knowledge hub** | Completeness + phase-gate readiness check |
| **Registers to stories** | Convert raw register entries → user stories directly |
| **What's next?** | Orientation — recommends the next step |
| **Give feedback** | Rate the last command / leave a note |

---

## End-to-End Timeline Summary

```
Setup ──► Session 1 ──► Session 2 ──► Build Backlog ──► Review xlsx
                                          (Full)
           Session 3 ──────────────────► Add to Backlog ──► Review xlsx
                                          (Delta)
                          ┌──► Generate FR ──► Generate Solution Comments
                          │    (if doing granular path)
                          │
                       Push to JIRA ──► Sync JIRA ──► Mark Refined ──► /design
```
